hardware_protocol.lifetime_cache_eviction: Alternate two separate inodes of one exact read-only probe; both owner orders start with cold APP loader

Original control passed lifetime workload, then next graphics fsput returned known stock PUT_BUSY. Added same warm reset after measured coalescence before independent graphics workload; no firmware workaround or threshold change.
Prepared strict read-only metadata probe additionally checks APP/prefix/other live-buffer overlaps.

Real candidate graphics load regression: old MPU setter assumed APP ended at guard. Fixed exact lease permissions and 256-aligned APP ends; gate charges 224. Added 260800 host spans,247 production ARM spans/image, cold-loader lifetimeHIL. Old production ELF reproduces rejected displaced span.

An unchanged APP is intentionally retained as a cache. The lifetime HIL alternates two separate inodes of the same exact bound probe to force actual cache eviction before measuring full idle coalescence. Both owner orders start with a cold APP loader; original assertions and thresholds remain.
